crossRefs.note: Don’t lust after her beauty in your heart, neither let her captivate you with her eyelids.
At evening, David arose from his bed and walked on the roof of the king’s house. From the roof, he saw a woman bathing…
“However, Job, please hear my speech, and listen to all my words.
Turn my eyes away from looking at worthless things. Revive me in your ways.
but I tell you that everyone who gazes at a woman to lust after her has committed adultery with her already in his…
If your eye causes you to stumble, cast it out. It is better for you to enter into God’s Kingdom with one eye, rather…
For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh, the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, isn’t the Father’s…

translations.web: Don’t look at the wine when it is red, when it sparkles in the cup, when it goes down smoothly.
translations.bsb: Do not gaze at wine while it is red, when it sparkles in the cup and goes down smoothly.
translations.kjv: Look not thou upon the wine when it is red, when it giveth his colour in the cup, when it moveth itself aright.
translations.asv: Look not thou upon the wine when it is red, When it sparkleth in the cup, When it goeth down smoothly:
